name: poster_curls
description: a screen-print poster: the set's bands as hard flat blocks of navy, orange, cream, plum, lilac, rust, yellow and blue, no gradients, curls at every scale
notes: From wallhaven-6d3zz6 (item 061). The smooth count cut on its rank into 24 flat sheets (`taper` 0.9), each reading one of the map's eight flat inks in turn (`hop` 0.125 from `phase` 0.0625, the middle of each plateau), so neighbouring bands are far apart in colour and nothing blends. Its three looks (paper_layers, poster_curls, gouache_cut) are one palette layer and one `paper` pass, told apart by which of the pass's members they set.

The reference is a tiling of interlocking dragon curves, which one escape loop does not draw: the bands nest round the set instead of interlocking. Round one's readings towards it: s_curv (sheets cut from the curvature average: feathered curls along every spiral arm, good at open spirals and pink noise at lace-heavy seats), s_shadow (the stack with a thin shadow, paper_layers' depth on the poster's inks). Tried and dropped: sheets cut from `stripe` and `tia` (busy combs), from `decomposition` (moire), and the stack under a stir (smeared bands with no curl).
The first map held two near-black inks (navy and plum) and every draft missed the near-black share (0.26 against 0.134); the plum was lifted and all six seats hold.
